waves.advisorWarning: Zalpa: Night sails off the western shore! A landing galley has hit the sand and an incendiary team is scouting our lower approaches!
Zalpa: Torches descending from the northern gorge! Man the ramparts and repel the raiders!
Tarkhunta: Second naval wave landing on the beach! Form the phalanx and loose arrows from the towers!
Zalpa: Major overland push through the northern ravines! Deploy our Royal War Chariots to sweep their flanks!
Burna-Khabir: The Shardana Fleet Warlord has come ashore in embossed bronze armor! Stand firm before the sacred Megaron—break their final assault!

primary.description: Ensure the Royal Megaron stands unbroken through the ferocious night assault.
Repel all 5 nocturnal assault waves breaking against the citadel.
Slay the Shardana Fleet Warlord leading the grand midnight invasion.

secondary.description: Accampamento d'Assedio: Raze the forward Sea Peoples war camp and barracks in the northern gorge to extinguish their raiding spawner.
Mura Inespugnabili: Keep at least 2 Cyclopean Watchtowers standing when dawn breaks.

narrative.briefing: Year 1178 BC. The shroud of night falls upon Kadesh-on-Sea, but the horizon blazes with pitch fire. The combined armada of the horned sails strikes under darkness. A forward war camp has established a siege base in the northern gorge, sending raiding parties against our gates. Fell ancient cedar groves to fuel the foundries, fortify the breaches with Cyclopean Ramparts, dispatch chariot sorties to burn their war camp, and defend the sacred Megaron against the Shardana Fleet Warlord!

dialogues.speaker: burna_khabir
dialogues.message: My Wanax, the skies rain embers and the sea roars with war horns. If the Megaron falls tonight, the cuneiform wisdom of three thousand years turns to ash.

dialogues.speaker: tarkhunta
dialogues.message: The cyclopean stones are laid true! Let the horned barbarians break their bronze blades against our megalithic ramparts!

dialogues.speaker: zalpa
dialogues.message: The enemy war camp is burning to cinders! Their flank reinforcements have ceased—now we crush their warlord at the gates!
